claims.statement: Acts narrates Jesus’ ascension and redirects the apostles from speculation about times toward Spirit-empowered witness.
Peter proclaims that the risen Jesus has been exalted at God’s right hand, has poured out the Spirit, and is Lord and Messiah.
Taken together, these passages support the lesson’s big idea: The ascension and exaltation present Jesus as reigning Lord who sends the Spirit and directs mission.
